security._comment: Phase 2 — telemetry signing. Provision a key with `pnpm keygen`. In production the private key lives in an ATECC608A/TPM, not on disk. Remove this block to publish unsigned (simulator-compatible).

control._comment: Phase 5 — SCADA control. Fetch the backend's command public key once from GET /api/energy/control/pubkey and save it here; the Edge only obeys commands it can verify. Remove this block to disable inbound control.
